verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Appwrite's CLI can push/pull configuration and manage resources, and its MCP server lets LLMs call SDK methods, but there is no documentation of a bulk/batch API (e.g., batch create, update, or delete across many rows/files/users) that would let an AI-native user perform true bulk operations. Missing for 10: explicit bulk create/update/delete endpoints or CLI commands operating on many items in one call, and any hands-on confirmation of such batch semantics.
